sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 2014
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XI OF 2014
ACT XI OF 2014
BALOCHISTAN CHIEF MINISTER AND PROVINCIAL MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES
AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2014
An Act further to amend the Balochistan Members (Salaries, Allowances and
Privileges) Act, 1975.
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 14th February, 2014]
No.PAB/Legis:
V (12)/2014, dated 14-2-2014.---The Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial
Ministers (Salaries, Allowances, and Privileges (Amendment) Bill, 2014, (Bill
No.12 of 2014), having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on
1st February, 2014 and assented to by the Governor, Balochistan on 14th
February, 2014 is hereby published as an Act of the Balochistan Provincial
Assembly.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient further to amend the
Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and
Privileges) Act III of 1975 in the manner hereinafter appearing:
It is
hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers'
(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 2014.
It
shall come into force at onc

2. Amendment
of Section 3 of Act III of 1975.---In
the Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers (Salaries, Allowances
and Privileges) Act, 1975 hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in Section 3
for the words "rupees thirty thousand and thirty five thousand" the
words "rupees ninety thousand and rupees one hundred thousand" shall

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 2014
sections.description:
Amendment of section 7-A of Act III of 1975

ACT XI OF 2014
ACT XI OF 2014
BALOCHISTAN CHIEF MINISTER AND PROVINCIAL MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES
AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2014
An Act further to amend the Balochistan Members (Salaries, Allowances and
Privileges) Act, 1975.
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 14th February, 2014]
4. Amendment
of section 7-A of Act III of 1975.---In
the said Act, for Section 7-A, the following shall be substituted:--
"The
Chief Minister and a Minister shall be entitled to telephone facilities at
office without ceiling and at residence upto a maximum ceiling of fifteen
thousand and ten thousand rupees respectively with official mobile phone connection
(SIM) both for official and private purpose throughout the term of their office
and for a period of fifteen days immediately thereafter. They will also be
entitled to free telephone facility while on tour where such facility is
available."

7. Amendment
of Section 9 of Act III of 1975.---In
the said Act in Section 9,--
(a) in
subsection (1) the full stop appearing at the end shall be substituted by colon
and thereafter the following new clause (i) shall be inserted--
"(i)
The Chief Minister and Minister shall be entitled to draw rupees six hundred
thousand and five hundred thousand per annum respectively in Travel vouchers or
Cash."
(b) in
subsection (2) for the words "first class and economy class
respectively" the words "Business Class" shall be substituted.
